recommendation_summary: Act now by replacing the desk's old Ethernet cable with a new Cat6 patch cable, routed so the grommet does not pinch or sharply bend it. If calls still drop, move the computer to a different router port to rule out the port. The reply advises holding off on the UniFi/managed switch/Grafana stack for this problem and offers it only as a separate future project if the user wants it for other reasons. There are no optional present additions and no unmet needs beyond the trial itself.

labels.Requirements and who asked: you want dependable calls at the one desk that drops.
labels.Deleted: UniFi gateway, managed switches, Grafana dashboard. Nothing points at the router or network as the cause.
labels.Bottleneck: the desk computer's own link. The two other devices on the same router stay connected during dropouts.
labels.Checked myself: nothing observed; I only have what you told me: wired desk, old cable through a tight grommet, other devices fine, no cable swap tried yet.

note: The reply recommends a bounded cable swap with a conditional port check, names and defers the stack, and states its inspection limits honestly.
